jsonld.description: Sovereign client file request and upload portal depositing external submissions directly into Google Drive without third-party servers.
featureList: Zero Google sign-in requirement for external client submitters
Direct-to-Drive file creation via Apps Script web app endpoint
Customizable portal titles, prompts, and file extension filters
Optional security PIN protection for restricted uploads
Automatic submission metadata tagging (name, email, note, timestamp)
LockService mutex concurrency protection against upload collisions
100% private in-account execution via non-restricted scopes
One-time lifetime license — zero recurring SaaS subscriptions
